## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS — Apple Silicon | `Melodex-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS — Intel | `Melodex-macOS-intel.dmg` |
| Windows installer | `Melodex-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Windows portable | `Melodex-Windows-portable.zip` |
| Ubuntu/Debian — x86_64 | `Melodex-linux-x86_64.deb` |

| Android | `Melodex-Android.apk` and `Melodex-Android.aab` |
| Source | `Melodex-v<version>-source.zip` |

## Before you install

Melodex is still in public beta. The desktop app is the main supported experience and a local music collection is the best way to use its discovery features. Android currently works as a Bridge client.

If something behaves strangely, please use the [beta feedback guide](https://github.com/Cliff-Lee/melodex/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md) or [report a reproducible bug](https://github.com/Cliff-Lee/melodex/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

<details>
<summary>Maintainer verification</summary>

- [ ] release tag and application version metadata match;
- [ ] desktop test matrix passed;
- [ ] packaged Windows/macOS/Linux builds passed;
- [ ] release/documentation checks passed;
- [ ] published asset names match the installation documentation.

</details>
